You know what nobody warns you about when you get a dog? The sheer amount of stuff you have to buy! I thought it was gonna be simple. Get a dog, buy some food, grab a leash, done. Nope! There's beds and crates and special shampoo and like forty different kinds of treats. And the toys! My living room looks like a pet store exploded in it. But honestly? Totally worth it. My dog, Charlie, is the best thing that's ever happened to me. He's this goofy little mutt who thinks he's a hundred pounds heavier than he actually is. He tries to sit on my lap and practically crushes me. And the walks! I've never been outside this much in my entire life. I've discovered parks in my neighborhood I didn't even know existed. My neighbors all know me now because of Charlie. Well, they know Charlie. I'm just "Charlie's human." I'm fine with that, honestly. He's way more charming than I am!
